name: 수련 분수 정원
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly water-lily fountain garden, symmetrical wide composition centered on a carved stone fountain surrounded by floating lily pads on rippling pond water; open unobstructed foreground, moonlight dances on the water against warm fountain-side lanterns, richly detailed carved stone and lily texture, deep layered garden view, polished fantasy concept art, the whole garden rendered in painterly cinematic tranquility.
